units.title: Discovered indoor units

unit_types.title: Unit type selection
unit_types.description:
Select the type for each indoor unit.

{unit_summary}

**VRF** – Variable Refrigerant Flow (multi-split system)
**RAC** – Room Air Conditioner (single-split wall unit)
**ATW** – Air to Water (hydronic heat pump)

The type determines which modes, fan speeds and temperature range are available.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway. Check the IP address and Modbus slave ID.
error.no_units_found: Connected to the gateway but no indoor units were detected. Make sure the units are powered on and correctly configured in the gateway.

init.title: Hitachi ModBus – Options
init.description:
Adjust the polling interval and correct the type of any unit.

{unit_summary}

**VRF** – Variable Refrigerant Flow (multi-split system)
**RAC** – Room Air Conditioner (single-split wall unit)
**ATW** – Air to Water (hydronic heat pump)

Changing a type reloads the integration and rebuilds that unit's entities.
